The Entity Management API publishes a tiered data-access model: "The Entity Management API allows users to request Unclassified ('Public'), Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) 'For Official Use Only' (FOUO) or CUI 'Sensitive' entity data, based on the sensitivity level of the user account".

The API's access model is fully documented on one public page: Individual (Personal) Accounts, System Accounts, API Key Rate Limits, and an API Extract for bulk retrieval — API keys are tied to SAM.gov accounts.
A machine-readable spec is published: the Entity Management API documentation carries an OpenAPI Specification File section with the downloadable spec.
